messages.content: Return one JSON object, without Markdown fences.

Return {"code": "...", "summary": "..."}. code must define parse_port(text: str) -> int in Python. Accept only nonempty ASCII decimal digits representing 1 through 65535 inclusive. Reject whitespace, signs, Unicode digits, zero and out-of-range values by raising ValueError. Leading zeroes are accepted. No imports or top-level effects. summary is a brief description in Chinese.
